articles.title: BONK faces $20 million treasury drain after attacker spends $4 million to pass malicious proposal
articles.snippet: The attacker bought enough of the memecoin's tokens to pass a governance proposal that sent the group's holdings to a wallet they controlled, then began selling.

articles.title: BonkDAO reports $20M theft from ‘malicious governance proposal’
articles.snippet: The developers behind the memecoin project said they had informed law enforcement after the attack and were working to “recover funds and identify those responsible.”

articles.title: Solana Meme Coin Bonk Treasury Drained of $20 Million in 'Malicious' Governance Attack
articles.snippet: The Bonk DAO wallet was exploited for roughly $20 million worth of the prominent dog-themed meme coin on Solana.
